japanese_evidence.summary: The official project does not publish a Japanese benchmark or supported-language guarantee; Japanese behavior must be measured on frozen fixtures.

blocking_reasons: Select and approve an immutable upstream commit.
Create or select an authorized target checkpoint and record its SHA-256 digest.

code.notes: Repository code is declared MIT; approval remains scoped to the pinned revision.

weights.notes: No separate blanket license for pretrained dependencies or target checkpoints is recorded.

training_data.notes: Audit base-training data, pitch/content dependencies, and the authorization and permitted use of every target recording.

inference_runtime.notes: Freeze and review ContentVec, RMVPE, FAISS, runtime dependencies, and redistribution boundaries.

audio_contract.notes: Read the native sample rate and context from the approved checkpoint; common v2 checkpoints are often 40 kHz, but that is not a pack-wide guarantee.

target_preparation.procedure: Train or approve one target-specific checkpoint and retrieval index from low-noise authorized speech, then freeze pitch extraction and preprocessing revisions.

resource_budget_hypothesis.notes: Initial worker envelope only. Measure warm and steady-state RAM, VRAM, and latency on the deployment host before freezing EXP-003.

blockers.summary: Source revision and weight digest are not approved or pinned.
blockers.clear_when: A reviewed commit, weight SHA-256, and approval record are recorded.

blockers.summary: Weight, data, and inference dependency rights are not fully cleared.
blockers.clear_when: The four-part license gate is approved for the intended deployment.

blockers.summary: No authorized target checkpoint and retrieval index have been selected.
blockers.clear_when: Authorized artifacts are produced, provenance-recorded, and digest-verified.

adapter_conformance.criterion: Pass the common adapter contract with fixed input, output, error, and generation fixtures.

warmup.criterion: Warmup reaches readiness within a frozen timeout and does not accept audio before ready.

cancel.criterion: Cancel stops model work and emits no output accepted for the canceled generation.

unload.criterion: Unload and repeated reload leave the worker healthy and release model resources.

vram.criterion: Measured peak and post-unload VRAM remain within the preregistered budget.

stt.criterion: Japanese STT preservation and exact high-consequence entities pass the frozen rule.

speaker.criterion: Authorized-target similarity improves under the calibrated preregistered speaker rule.

integrity.criterion: Finite samples, clipping, duration, silence, repetition, and discontinuity guardrails pass.

decision_notes: Implement first after approval because RVC is the most mature practical realtime baseline in the reviewed candidate set; this priority is not an experiment result.
